authors: Choi YS, Yin RT, Pfenniger A, Koo J, et al.

read_locators.locator: PDF p3 / article p1229, Design of bioresorbable, battery-free cardiac pacemakers
read_locators.read: Rx W/Mg dual coil; PLGA dielectric and encapsulation; Si NM PIN diode; capacitor-free rectification; flexible W/Mg extension; bipolar exposed contact pad.

read_locators.locator: PDF p3 / article p1229 last paragraph and PDF p19 Extended Data Fig4 caption
read_locators.read: Waveform generator RF bursts, amplifier, Tx and Rx coils, inductive power transfer; diode produces approximately DC cathodal output at pads. Extended Data4 image was not inspected; only caption read.

read_locators.locator: PDF p4 / article p1230, Fig1a–d and full caption
read_locators.read: Exactly one complete original figure viewed; a device layers and contacts; b in-vitro dissolution photos; c proposed inductive operation; d proposed later bioresorption.

read_locators.locator: PDF p5 / article p1231, In vivo pacing in a large-animal model; PDF p14 Methods, In vivo canine model study
read_locators.read: Waveform generator/amplifier drive Tx; surface limb electrodes connected to six-lead ECG. Effective capture confirmed by surface ECG. No feedback controller described.
Animal proof-of-concept; sensor integration for closed-loop operation is a future direction. Human tissue experiments were ex vivo, not clinical implantation.

read_locators.locator: PDF p13–14, Preparation of human ventricular heart slices and Optical mapping
read_locators.read: Discarded donor heart slices and evoked optical action potentials; this is not human clinical pacemaker validation.

observed: Exploded layered receiver plus flexible extension and paired exposed contacts in Fig1a.
Fig1c depicts a Tx coil outside body and receiver near heart; this is labeled proposed utilization, not proof of a deployed clinical system.
Dissolution photographs and arrow to later resorption have temporal semantics, not data/feedback.
not_viewed: Other full original figures including Fig4 and Extended Data4; their relevant text/captions were read.

scope: Draw functional wireless power/control chain plus canine experimental ECG observation. Do not model detailed circuit, measured waveforms, resorption kinetics, or human treatment efficacy.
